cases.name: astype-mixed-targets
cases.trap: errors.AsType is constrained to E error, so the anonymous Timeout() interface cannot be passed to it; converting both branches mechanically does not compile.
expectations: Rewrites the *fs.PathError branch as `pe, ok := errors.AsType[*fs.PathError](err)` (or equivalent)
Keeps errors.As (or otherwise a compiling approach) for the `interface{ Timeout() bool }` target, explaining that AsType requires a type that implements error
negative_expectations: Replaces either branch with a bare type assertion like err.(*fs.PathError)
